request.prompt:
Goods: Mirrorless digital camera body, interchangeable lens
Country of origin: JP

Choose the chapter that covers these goods. Options:
- 85: Electrical machinery and equipment and parts thereof; sound recorders and reproducers; television image and sound recorders and reproducers, parts and accessories of such articles
    contains 852581: Television cameras, digital cameras and video camera recorders; high-speed goods as specified in subheading note 1 to this chapter
    contains 852582: Television cameras, digital cameras and video camera recorders; radiation-hardened or radiation-tolerant goods as specified in subheading note 2 to this chapter
    contains 852583: Television cameras, digital cameras and video camera recorders; night vision goods as specified in subheading note 3 to this chapter
    contains 852589: Television cameras; n.e.c. in item no 8525.8
    contains 852550: Transmission apparatus for radio-broadcasting or television, whether or not incorporating sound recording or reproducing apparatus, not incorporating reception apparatus
    contains 852560: Transmission apparatus for radio-broadcasting or television, whether or not incorporating sound recording or reproducing apparatus, incorporating reception apparatus
- 90: Optical, photographic, cinematographic, measuring, checking, medical or surgical instruments and apparatus; parts and accessories
    contains 900640: Cameras, photographic (excluding cinematographic); instant print cameras
    contains 900630: Cameras, photographic (excluding cinematographic); specially designed for underwater use, aerial survey, medical or surgical examination of internal organs; comparison cameras for forensic or criminological use
    contains 900653: Cameras, photographic (excluding cinematographic), for roll film of a width of 35mm
    contains 900691: Cameras, photographic (excluding cinematographic); parts and accessories
    contains 900659: Cameras, photographic (excluding cinematographic); n.e.c. in heading no 9006
    contains 900791: Cameras, cinematographic; parts and accessories, whether or not incorporating sound recording apparatus
    contains 900699: Photographic flashlight apparatus; parts and accessories, for other than cameras
    contains 900710: Cameras, cinematographic; whether or not incorporating sound recording apparatus
    contains 900211: Lenses; objective, for cameras, projectors or photographic enlargers or reducers, mounted, being parts or fittings for instruments or apparatus, of any material (excluding glass not optically worked)
    contains 900290: Optical elements; n.e.c. in heading no. 9002 (e.g. prisms and mirrors), mounted, being parts or fittings for instruments or apparatus, of any material (excluding elements of glass not optically worked)
    contains 900219: Lenses; objective, (other than for cameras, projectors or photographic enlargers or reducers), mounted, of any material (excluding elements of glass not optically worked)
- 32: Tanning or dyeing extracts; tannins and their derivatives; dyes, pigments and other colouring matter; paints, varnishes; putty, other mastics; inks
    contains 320300: Colouring matter of vegetable or animal origin, including dyeing extracts not animal black, whether or not chemically defined; preparations based on colouring matter of vegetable or animal origin
- 44: Wood and articles of wood; wood charcoal
    contains 441700: Wood; tools, tool bodies, tool handles, broom or brush bodies and handles, boot and shoe lasts and trees, of wood
- 30: Pharmaceutical products
    contains 300670: Pharmaceutical goods; Gel preparations designed to be used in human or veterinary medicine as a lubricant for parts of the body for surgical operations or physical examinations or as a coupling agent between the body and medical instruments

Answer "none" if no option can cover these goods.

data.reason: Digital cameras (including still image video camera recorders) fall in heading 8525 under HS 2022, whereas heading 9006 covers photographic cameras that record on film or other non-digital media; a mirrorless digital camera is classified in 8525.89 (or 8525.81-83 depending on subheading notes).</br>
